import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:n+1]
    
    arr.sort()
    
    itv = data[n+1]
    
    max_count = 0
    for left in range(n):
        right = left
        while right < n and arr[right] <= arr[left] + itv:
            right += 1
        max_count = max(max_count, right - left)
    
    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
